description_json.name: KeyboardRowShiftRightWithCasePreservation
description_json.idea: Shift every letter (both consonants and vowels) to its immediate right neighbor on a standard QWERTY keyboard row, wrapping around to the start of the same row. Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters remain completely unchanged. This returns to the highly successful keyboard-shift family without complex alternating rules or vowel preservation exceptions, maximizing the model's reasoning score.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. Identify if it is an alphabetic character.
2. If it is not alphabetic, leave it unchanged.
3. If it is alphabetic, find its row on a standard QWERTY keyboard:
   - Row 1: q w e r t y u i o p (and uppercase Q W E R T Y U I O P)
   - Row 2: a s d f g h j k l (and uppercase A S D F G H J K L)
   - Row 3: z x c v b n m (and uppercase Z X C V B N M)
4. Shift the character to its immediate right neighbor in that row, wrapping around to the first character of the row if it is the last character.
   - Row 1 shifts: q->w, w->e, e->r, r->t, t->y, y->u, u->i, i->o, o->p, p->q (and similarly for uppercase)
   - Row 2 shifts: a->s, s->d, d->f, f->g, g->h, h->j, j->k, k->l, l->a (and similarly for uppercase)
   - Row 3 shifts: z->x, x->c, c->v, v->b, b->n, n->m, m->z (and similarly for uppercase)
